import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
W=str(Path('write_lane.py').resolve())
def save(n,s):subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',W,n],input=s if isinstance(s,str) else json.dumps(s,indent=2),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
b=Path('ACTUALBRIEF.md').read_text().replace('to325093','to325097');save('ACTUALBRIEF.md',b)
ids=json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids'];r=json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text());assert set(r)==set(map(str,ids)) and len(r)==20
p=json.loads(Path('provenance.json').read_text());assert len(p)==20
for o in p:
 raw=Path('literals/'+str(o['id'])+'.jsonl').read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==o['raw_sha256'];assert raw.endswith(b'\n');assert hashlib.sha256(o['raw_statement_token'].encode()).hexdigest()==o['raw_statement_sha256'];assert json.loads(o['raw_statement_token'])==o['statement']
assert hashlib.sha256(Path('reservation.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='80cbc15d7faa9ddefb5fbc5e9dd17c4445363eb1f9150114427c2fcd458377f2'
receipts=[]
for f in sorted(Path('.').glob('*.receipt.json')):
 o=json.loads(f.read_text());receipts.append({'file':str(f),'exit':o.get('exit'),'wall_s':o.get('wall_s'),'sampled_rss_bytes':o.get('sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes'),'killed':o.get('killed')})
failed=[o for o in receipts if o['exit'] not in [0,None]]
save('resource-inventory.json',{'completed_before_this_invocation':receipts,'failed_receipts':failed,'limitations':'Sampling misses transients; native search telemetry and separate writer peaks unavailable. This invocation and terminal seal have their own receipts generated afterwards; inspect manifest for all completed receipts. Bootstrap and standalone verifiers are cap exceptions. No background jobs.'})
save('FINALCHECK.json',{'ids':ids,'count':20,'raw_record_and_statement_token_hashes_match':True,'reservation_sha256_matches':True,'qualified_survivors':0,'accepted_credit':0,'new_network_denials':0,'native_search_calls':3,'native_querystrings':9,'formal_runs':0,'children':0,'remaining_gates':'Per-ID results; no novelty clearance for parked targets; root-only acceptance','terminal_self_exclusions':['MANIFEST.json','seal_manifest.receipt.json','seal_manifest.output.txt']})
print('20 exact raw records and statement tokens verified; reservation unchanged; zero qualified survivors.')
